wn103a1: Prologue: its own world on the map, where Leila Chen trains UNIT-7 — and where she is taken
wn103a2: Bonus rooms: a hidden entrance leads to a sealed room full of coins, five different layouts
wn103a4: Hidden blocks: invisible until you hit them from below
wn103a5: A “What's new” section — this very screen
wn103a6: Leaderboard: campaign, endless and hardcore are three separate standings
wn103a7: Frozen enemies became blocks of ice: they fall, slide and knock each other down in a chain
wn103a8: The world map shows how many coins you have collected in total and on each level
wn103a9: The account button shows your avatar from your Pixset Studio profile
wn103a10: Run style in the settings: Relaxed keeps your checkpoint after all lives are gone, and a fall returns you to the ledge you jumped from
wn103a11: Spectator mode online: once you are out you watch the others, switch between them and can leave without waiting for the level to end
wn103a12: A shared world online: coins, blocks, power-ups, crystals and keys are the same for the whole room, and everyone sees everyone's shots
wn103a13: An arrow points to players off screen — you can see who ran ahead, who fell behind and by how much
wn103a14: Corner notifications: who joined the room and who left
wn103a15: The host can allow joining a level already in progress — otherwise a newcomer waits for the next one
wn103a16: Daily level: five challenges, new every day — easy, normal, hard and two random ones. Unlimited attempts, your best one counts
wn103a17: The ghost of a best run races beside you: your own record, the daily leader or the level leader. Switched on in the settings, off by default
wn103a18: Leaderboards can be viewed by world, by your own country or among friends only
wn103a19: Sign in with your nickname, not only with your email
wn103a20: An “Online” section gathers the daily level and co-op play in one place
wn103c1: The settings moved to the corner of the screen, like the account button
wn103c2: The loading screen shows the percentage, the stages and how much data has arrived
wn103c3: Level quirks became rare: no more than one per level, and a third of levels have none
wn103c4: Flagpole: the higher you grab the flag, the more points you get
wn103c5: The game starts faster: it loads one language instead of all fifty at once
wn103c6: The graphics quality setting now controls all of the glow, not just part of it
wn103c7: A public player profile now carries far more numbers: records, coins, bosses, secrets, combat statistics
wn103c8: Multiplayer rooms work where the old server cannot be reached: the game finds a working route by itself, and a room code works no matter which server opened for whom
wn103c9: Glow is capped at one hundred per cent: above that it stopped lighting the picture and started flooding it
wn103c10: The frame counter shows an honest number and frame time, and the frame and backdrop are gone — it no longer covers anything
wn103c11: In the rainbow world every object takes the colour, not almost every one; with refraction off the shimmer settles into a static gradient and the frame costs less
wn103f1: The finish no longer appears inside a bonus room
wn103f2: You can no longer escape a bonus room through the top and run to the finish
wn103f3: A hidden block no longer stands in front of a crystal and locks it away
wn103f4: The lava world no longer glitches on the first drawn frame
wn103f5: Fixed a rare drawing failure: on some levels enemies could vanish from the screen
wn103f6: The “What's new” button no longer hangs around on the victory and defeat screens
wn103f7: Dying in the prologue restarts the prologue instead of dropping you into the first campaign level
wn103f8: The second flag in the middle of a level is gone: a level has one finish again
wn103f9: Hitting a coin block from below in quick succession no longer throws the player sideways
wn103f10: A player leaving an online room no longer makes everyone else wait for them at the flag
wn103f11: A host change mid-level no longer freezes the room forever
wn103f12: Leaving a room for the menu no longer leaves other players in your next single-player game
wn103f13: Other players no longer glide through the level without animation — their walk, landing and idle all work
wn103f14: The touch buttons disappear after you leave a room
wn103f15: Animation speed no longer depends on the frame rate: on fast monitors coins, springs, the world map and the cutscenes ran two and a half times faster
wn103f16: The ghost no longer vanishes mid-level, and a failed attempt no longer overwrites the recording of a run you finished
wn103f17: Installing an update no longer signs you out of your account
wn103f18: Other players online move smoothly on a monitor of any refresh rate
wn102a1: A secret 11th world, “Prism Anomaly”: 10 levels, its own boss and the resolution of the story
wn102a2: Rainbow shards — one in every world, all ten unlock the secret world
wn102a3: Operator profile: avatars, callsign, ranks, statistics and an archive of story scenes
wn102a4: Status effects: burning, freezing, EMP failure and corrosion
wn102a5: Versions for Android and for the browser
wn102c1: The world map was redrawn on canvas
wn102c2: A full translation into 49 languages — all of it, not in pieces
wn102c3: A frame became 2–3 times cheaper, automatic quality was added
wn102f1: Four bosses were impossible to beat at all — fixed
wn102f2: A black screen when launching the .exe on some graphics cards
wn101c1: Bug fixes and better performance. Nothing else changed in this build.
wn100a1: 100 levels across 10 worlds, each world with its own boss
wn100a2: Co-op for up to 5 players through a relay server
wnArchiveIntro: A separate line of versions before the first release — eight builds, each a single HTML file.
wnA010: A prototype called NEON RUN: one endless level, no map, no themes, no bosses
wnA020: Renamed to Byte Blaster: a world map, 10 themed worlds, progress saving
wnA040: Four kinds of power-ups instead of two, star music, locked mode cards
wnA050: Cutscenes and a second set of themes
wnA060: Hardcore mode — the last build before 1.0.0
